snippet.title: Ironclad - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Ironclad is a co-op horror game where you and a small crew pilot tanks to eradicate the monster infestation plaguing the world. Work together and find ancient technology to end the scourge once and for all.

*Wishlist on Steam!*
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3545560/Ironclad/

* Objective:
With up to 6 players, drive, shoot, repair, and upgrade your tanks while traversing across a treacherous land inhabited by powerful eldritch horrors in search of the ultimate weapon. Find refuge at safe points and don't forget to keep an eye on your oxygen levels.

* Team Up:
Take your pick between driving and shooting in team-piloted tanks. Do you split up or stick together as you search for supplies and artifacts to combat the brutal landscape?

* Defend Yourself:
While running might be your best option, it's not your only option. Find weapons, ammo, and health packs to fight off monsters and stay alive, even if just barely. And of course, blow some stuff up with your tanks!

* Never Give Up:
Don't worry, if your body gets destroyed (and it will), your spirit lives on! Your friends have enough of your DNA  to construct you a new body in the resurrection pods.
